dirtyTitle: This connection has unsaved remote files
dirtyDescription: Closing the connection will not delete editor drafts. Drafts remain in local memory. After reconnecting to the same server, verify the host fingerprint and file version before binding them again.
themeSaveFailed: Theme preference was not saved. Open Settings to review the error.
paletteDescription: Search servers, switch tabs, or open common actions. Use arrow keys to browse, Enter to run, and Esc to close.
searchPlaceholder: Search servers, switch tabs, or enter an action…
noMatches: No matching servers, tabs, or actions.
manageConnectionsDetail: Add, edit, or manage trusted hosts
aiDetail: Review and confirm AI suggestions; commands are never run automatically
trustReuse: Connections reuse trusted fingerprints and the existing authentication flow
sessionChanged: The active SSH session changed. Refresh SFTP and try opening the file again.
editorLimit: You can open up to 20 remote files. Close some editor tabs first.
readOnlyPreview: File opened in read-only preview mode.
openRemoteFailed: Could not open the remote file. Check its type, size, and access permissions.
exitDirtyDescription: Quitting clears editor drafts held in this run. Cancel and save any files you want to keep.
aiSafetyAnnouncement: AI sends context from the current SSH session only after you review and confirm it. Generated commands are never run automatically.
